Hey there—

Tell me if this sounds about right.

Every day you’re juggling people, projects, and expectations. There are tasks to do, discussions to have, decisions to make, files to share, deadlines to hit, relationships to manage, and work to deliver.

This all has to happen somewhere. But you’ve discovered that spreading everything across different apps, browser tabs, emails, and chats doesn’t work. You need a system.

Unfortunately, most project management systems are bloated, complicated, and confusing. And software that’s hard to use doesn’t get used.

20 years ago we were in the same boat. We needed something capable, but also straightforward, easy, and reliable. Nothing fit. So we invented Basecamp, and have been improving it ever since. In software, longevity like this isn’t luck — it’s proof it works. And in 2026 we released the all-new Basecamp 5, packing decades of experience into our best version yet.

Today, Basecamp is used across every industry, and nearly a million people, teams, companies, and non-profits worldwide rely on it daily for all sorts of things. Plus, it’s famously affordable — especially for small and medium-sized businesses.

Thanks for checking us out. We invite you to give Basecamp a try. And ultimately, we’d be honored to have you as a customer.

Jason Fried, jason@basecamp.com
Co-founder & CEO

Take a minute to meet some of our customers

They’re product developers, woodworkers, music industry folks, logistics pros, publishers, event planners, marketers, architects, artists, software designers, brand strategists, educators…

Play this 1-minute video

We asked our customers: “What changed for the better since you switched to Basecamp?”

Simply put, we get more work done, quicker, and better. Productivity is up. Errors are down. Clients are happier. Patrick Sheffield, Moore Communications Group
Since using Basecamp, our communication is drastically better and deadlines are met without drama. Shannon Kropf, Full Sail University
Info is flowing like water. A lot more transparency. Everyone is on the same page. No more secrets and blindspots. Aaron Bingaman, Penn State OEM
I no longer have to wonder whether I’ve asked for something… Every member of my team is more accountable. John Drover, Roebothan McKay Marshall
Basecamp makes us tighter as a group. Basecamp makes it easy to create shared understanding in our company. Teddy Zetterlund, Lägenhetsbyte
We don’t have to contact each other about every little thing. When we need to know something, it’s right there. Kelly Hunter, Chamber Nation
Our church is loving Basecamp. It’s so easy to use even the 80-year-olds on our committee are using it! Blake Rider, St. Stephen’s Episcopal Church
It eliminated the need for extra communication and reduced a lot of miscommunication between my team. Anthony Clark, Clark Partners Realty Group
Check out over 1,000 more customer testimonials

How about a quick demonstration?

No slides, no sales pitch. Just a real project, clicked through in real time. A wonderful way to get comfortable with Basecamp.

See how Basecamp works

Big numbers. Highly-trusted. Rugged, reliable, ready.

Thousands of people are working in Basecamp right now.
  • 84 million accounts
  • 60 million projects
  • 72 million check-in answers
  • 350 million messages
  • 1.7 billion to-dos
  • 2.7 billion comments
  • 2.2 billion files
  • 2.3 billion pings
  • 675 million boosts
  • 5 petabytes of data
  • 200 million scheduled events
  • 180 million to-do lists
  • 1 billion @mentions
  • 545 million to-dos completed
  • 15 billion notifications
  • 233 countries
  • 52,000 cities
  • 99.99% uptime

Remember when companies cared about service?

We still do! Staffed by incredible humans, we’re here for you 24/7/365.

Meet Eron, our Head of Technical Ops

Durable infrastructure

Rather than rent cloud hosting, we own and run our hardware across multiple data centers. We specified the hardware, configured (and sometimes invented) the software, and optimized every detail for speed and reliability. We’ve maintained an industry-leading 99.99% uptime record for years.

Meet Chase, our Head of Support

Dependable customer service

At most companies, customer service is treated as an afterthought, something to outsource, a place to cut costs. At Basecamp it’s one of our best features. Our customers consistently rave about our kind, patient, and deeply knowledgeable staff. Everyone on the team can answer any question.

Want to see a live demo and ask some questions first?

We’ll show you how to set up Basecamp in minutes, how to roll it out to your team, and Q&A covering anything else you’d like to ask. See all upcoming classes.

Have a great day!

Join more than 200,000 people who get our email newsletter. We’ll share product updates, thoughts, new releases, and other tidbits we think you’ll find interesting.

Enter a valid email address.
